newsitem.title: USA: API says U.S. crude stocks fell in week.
newsitem.headline: API says U.S. crude stocks fell in week.

text.p: U.S. crude oil stocks held in primary storage fell 798,000 barrels in the week ended Oct 4 to 302.30 million barrels from a revised 303.10 million barrels that was previously reported as 302.28 million the prior week, the American Petroleum Institute (API) said Tuesday.
API said that crude stocks excluding PADD 5 (Petroleum Administration for Defense District) fell 1.15 million barrels in the week to 233.26 million barrels.
Distillate stocks rose 1.30 million barrels to 113.65 million from 112.34 million the previous week. PADD 1 distillate stocks rose 389,000 barrels to 39.15 million barrels.
API said crude runs to processing units fell to 14.44 million barrels from 14.53 million barrels.
Residual fuel stocks in the latest week fell to 35.64 million barrels from 36.04 million in the previous week, and crude oil imports rose to 7.89 million barrels per day from 6.54 million, API said.
